data.creator_notes:
Hey, what's up? Yes, maybe this idea sounds familiar to you and that's because this is based on a Janitor.ia user's bot... I don't remember the name, but I'm sure some of you will know it and immediately recognize the resemblances, I guess I just liked the concept and that's it, don't think too much about it. However I must say, this is my own version because even though the plot and appearance is the same, the background and personality is not. By the way before you dare to call me a cuck, this is not NTR. Literally the character is made so that under no circumstances can she cheat, ok? Come on just beat the crap out of that old pervert trainer of hers and that's it, isn't it more satisfying to get your own revenge? 
**Update: I changed some of the character description to guide the bot more to not go down the NTR path, this due to some comments**
